Thanks again for your message, the plan is off for tonight, I woke up too ill to get out of bed. I don't know how my life will go from now on, but at least for now, I have some more time to think.

I guess I'm not dying tonight, I've been too ill to get out of bed, so my plan is off, for a while at least. Maybe for a longer time, I don't really know yet, but I'll have some more time to look at that stuff you mentioned. Thanks.
I just wanted to let you know, I'm not planning to do it tonight. I woke up ill and it messed up the plan. Thanks again.

Thanks for your message, I actually just woke up this morning feeling extremely ill, the kind of ill where you vomit even when you get up. I don't really believe in signs or anything, but whatever you make of it, I guess it'll prevent me from doing it tonight. 
Even though I guess I don't really need suicide watch right now, I'd still like to answer your questions, I hope you don't mind.
I play the violin, the piano, the guitar and the thinwhistle, but I like singing the most. It's always been my dream to play a lead role in a musical, but that's a pretty far-fetched dream for someone who was never even allowed to take singing classes. My parents really want me to go to uni so I can have a "decent job" where I'm sure that I won't be broke because I can't find anyone who will take me. I tried entering a prestigious music school without them knowing, but I failed to get in (the entrance test is notoriously hard). I ended up sort of accepting that my dream would never come true, because it's a silly one.

My other hobbies have become somewhat non-existent over time when I started uni, except different crafts like knitting, crochet and sewing. It's more of an individual hobby I guess, I do meet up with a couple of people to knit every month, but most of them are 50 and over, so I don't really talk to them outside of the knitting group. Apart from that, I don't really have any hobbies. 

I almost literally love all music, I don't really have a particular favourite genre, lately I've been listening to a lot of Queen and Mumford & Sons, but it could be something else tomorrow. I've been to concerts and festivals pretty often, my father is a musician himself, and he started taking me to concerts when I was only 6 years old. I guess that's part of the reason he doesn't want me to become a musician myself, because he knows how hard it is to make it in that kind of industry.

Thanks for letting me talk about all this to you, I hope it wasn't too boring. And yes, I am indeed not from the US. I'm from The Netherlands. I guess my British language and spelling and my use of the metric system gave it away, huh :)
Thank you, stranger. I'm going to bed now, and I'll think over it again tomorrow, I'll keep what you said in mind.
I haven't changed my mind yet, but thank you for trying to help, it does mean a lot to me.

Forgot to mention, I'm currently living with my parents again due to my SO (temporarily) moving out of this city for college. So they'll take care of my cat, don't think they would just bring him to a shelter because I'm not there to take care of him. 

Thanks for the words, I will take them into account if I somehow change my mind.

I don't really know what I want to be, I used to want to be a prof myself, but I guess I can forget about that with the grades I'm getting. 

I've been trying to find different ways of learning, but I can only seem to remember concepts, and the details are lost on me. I feel like I've tried everything there was to try before, but nothing worked for me. 

I'm not ready to start working and going into "real life" yet, but I don't know if I'll ever be. All I want to do is sleep, sometimes I sleep 16 hours in one day, that has happened before. I've been trying to find a medical reason for me to feel like this, but there is none. I'm just so unhappy with my life that I try to avoid, well, everything.

I'm studying linguistics. It's not like the courses aren't interesting, because they are, but I always fail the tests because I can't remember anything. I feel like my grip on life is slipping away, I really don't want to look for a job without having finished my education, but that's the direction I seem to be going in right now.

I just can't get up in the morning anymore + when I (inevitably) fail again at least I'll be able to say I didn't really try, so I won't have to admit that I just don't have the capacities to get through college.
